scope: Individual replacement geometry and assembly dependencies. Printer-specific slicing and physical fit remain separate.

parts.name: Split jaw main body
parts.reason: The one-piece passive bearing traps the assembled motor shaft. The removable cheek allows rigid assembly.

parts.name: Removable passive-side jaw cheek
parts.reason: Retains the original complete coaxial bearing; two M2.5 × 8 tapping screws close the cheek after the jaw is seated.

parts.name: Lower lip pad with internal access relief
parts.reason: Provides room for the cheek joints and screwdriver without changing the exposed lip surface.

parts.name: Curved lower head shell with seat clearance
parts.reason: Held: the populated first-generation Zero W needs a revised internal board/header window. The pictured earlier jaw-clearance shell must not be reprinted for the current electronics layout; the revised shell is awaiting integrated assembly checks.

parts.name: Restored curved cap with internal mounts
parts.reason: Restores the original curved head and provides controller/audio mounts. Complete cable routing may still change openings or mounts.

parts.name: Face panel with internal camera anchors
parts.reason: Supports the eye camera before fitting the Pi. Camera ribbon routing must be settled before freezing its position.

parts.name: Eye trim with camera clearance
parts.reason: Clears the eye-mounted camera lens and its checked field of view; follows the final camera pose.

parts.name: Removable internal camera frame
parts.old: Replaces the rooftop foot and cradle
parts.reason: Held: eye-camera fastening is being revised for rear access before Pi installation. The earlier six-screw frame is not the current manufacturing release; final screw direction, supporting frame and cable clearance remain under review.

parts.name: Speaker lower cradle
parts.old: New part; replaces the old combined audio carrier
parts.reason: Supports the purchased speaker frame inside the curved cap; wire exits and terminal access must pass before release.

parts.name: Speaker rear keeper
parts.reason: Retains the speaker from the rear while leaving its diaphragm free. Install after the prewired amplifier.

parts.name: Head-pitch bracket with even-length screw seats
parts.reason: Adds 1 mm under the four ID13 output screw heads for M2 × 6 tapping screws; clears the four existing thin bore membranes.

parts.name: Left lower-leg link with even-length screw seats
parts.reason: Optional new-build replacement with four integral 1 mm screw seats for M2 × 6 tapping screws. It is not an instruction to dismantle the completed legs. A separate conditional washer repair preserves the existing links and force-fitted ankles.

parts.name: Right lower-leg link with even-length screw seats
parts.reason: Optional new-build replacement with four integral 1 mm screw seats for M2 × 6 tapping screws. It is not an instruction to dismantle the completed legs. A separate conditional washer repair preserves the existing links and force-fitted ankles.

keepExisting.name: Ankles, feet and completed lower joints
keepExisting.reason: User reports them seated. Their redesign is deferred.

keepExisting.name: Torso base, rings and power support
keepExisting.reason: The demonstrated issue is assembly order: install closed rings before joining the legs and power support after fastening.

keepExisting.name: IMU clamp and cover
keepExisting.reason: Approach the IMU clamp from negative X. Use M2 × 6 pressure screws with the specified 1.8 mm head stand-off; no geometry change.

keepExisting.name: Original complete jaw motor support and upper lip pad
keepExisting.reason: Retained by the current split-jaw candidate.

corrections: 撤回为新走线路径派生的颈部开槽、可拆承载件和新增线夹；它们不是已证实的原版必改件。

保留原主体和控制板位置。相机排线在自行设定的保守模型下失败，不代表必须迁板或重做鸭头。

assembly: 头盖打开时接线：橙色SC1892 Standard–Mini 200mm宽端接Camera Module 3，窄端接第一代Pi Zero W。
先打开锁扣，金属触点朝各自PCB，平直插牢后锁好；托住板，保持两端加固段平直。
余线沿Pi板边和板面外侧空隙自然回折，避开小元件、功放、螺丝座和盖缝；无需折成示例曲线。
观察着缓慢合盖；若夹线或拉紧，重新整理后再紧固，不靠螺丝压合。完整步骤见本机包内 ASSEMBLY-REVIEW.txt。
